title: Community Market Rates for Systems Settlements, Calloway Limited Home Warranty
content:
Sierra Vista Ranch 1.30; Mesquite Trails and Harbor Pines 1.15; every other community 1.00. These are the systems market multipliers of a systems-item cash settlement under the Calloway Limited Home Warranty, applied to the program's cash-in-lieu maximum in the scheduled systems settlement.

**Rule.** The systems market multiplier follows the community named on the home's Home Purchase Agreement, the purchase agreement under which Calloway sold the home: Sierra Vista Ranch takes 1.30; Mesquite Trails or Harbor Pines takes 1.15; any other community takes 1.00, that is, no adjustment.

| Community on the Home Purchase Agreement | Systems market multiplier |
|---|---|
| Sierra Vista Ranch | 1.30 |
| Mesquite Trails | 1.15 |
| Harbor Pines | 1.15 |
| any other community | 1.00 |

Hypothetical illustration: a home sold under a Home Purchase Agreement naming Harbor Pines takes 1.15; one naming Cedar Hollow takes 1.00.
